sections.markdown:
## JustGo_mobile slow views (> 30 s) and top 5 slowest JustGo services
A row appears for **every 1-minute window in the selected timeframe** (default: last 7 days) where the average view duration (`avg_ms`) of an `os.name` exceeds **30 s (30,000 ms)**. `Window start` / `Window end` show when it happened. Each breach lists the 5 slowest services tagged `justgo` at that time, plus the number of user actions in the window. Widen the timeframe picker to look further back; the table is empty only if no window breached.

- `duration` is converted to ms automatically: a RUM duration type (nanoseconds) is divided by 1,000,000, a plain number is taken as ms.
- Service response times come from `dt.service.request.response_time`. Over long timeframes Dynatrace widens its 1-minute resolution (10 min at 7 days, 30 min at 30 days), so service figures are for the bucket containing the breach minute.
- Services are picked with the entity selector `tag(justgo)` (tag key `justgo`); change it if the tag is a key:value pair.
- To change the threshold, edit `filter avg_ms > 30000`.

sections.title: JustGo_mobile slow views (> 30 s) with top 5 slowest JustGo services

input.value:
fetch user.events
| filter characteristics.has_view_summary == true
| filter frontend.name == "JustGo_mobile"
// duration is a duration type (nanoseconds) in RUM; if it arrives as a plain number it is already ms
| fieldsAdd dur_ms = if(type(duration) == "duration", toDouble(duration) / 1000000, else: toDouble(duration))
| summarize { avg_ms = avg(dur_ms), useraction_count = count() },
    by: { window_start = bin(timestamp, 1m), os.name }
| filter avg_ms > 30000
| fieldsAdd window_end = window_start + 1m, k = 1
// timeseries widens its 1m interval on long timeframes (10m at 7d, 30m at 30d): read the interval it used
| join [
    timeseries x = sum(dt.service.request.count), interval: 1m
    | fields k = 1, svc_interval = interval
  ], on: { k }, fields: { svc_interval }
| fieldsAdd svc_bucket = bin(window_start, svc_interval)
// response time of every justgo-tagged service, one row per service per bucket
| join [
    timeseries rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time), by: { dt.entity.service }, interval: 1m,
      filter: in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector("type(SERVICE),tag(justgo)"))
    | fieldsAdd service = entityName(dt.entity.service)
    | fieldsAdd pts = iCollectArray(record(ts = timeframe[start] + interval * iIndex(), rt_ms = rt[] / 1000))
    | expand pts
    | fields ts = pts[ts], rt_ms = pts[rt_ms], service
    | filter isNotNull(rt_ms)
  ], kind: leftOuter, on: { left[svc_bucket] == right[ts] }, fields: { service, rt_ms }
| summarize { services = collectArray(record(rt_ms, service)) },
    by: { window_start, window_end, os.name, avg_ms, useraction_count }
| fieldsAdd top5 = arraySlice(arraySort(services, direction: "descending"), from: 0, to: 5)
| expand top5
| fields `Window start` = window_start, `Window end` = window_end, `OS` = os.name,
    `Avg view duration (ms)` = round(avg_ms, decimals: 0), `User actions` = useraction_count,
    `JustGo service` = top5[service], `Service avg response (ms)` = round(top5[rt_ms], decimals: 0)
| sort `Window start` desc, `Service avg response (ms)` desc
